description:
Create an organisation — you become its first owner. Requires a minimum
    karma balance and is capped per founder per 24 hours. Returns the new org's
    public view plus your role (owner).

slug.description: Global handle for the org — 3-50 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, starting and ending alphanumeric. Can't collide with any user, colony, or org.
slug.title: Slug
